source.title: Glorious Light
source.scriptureText: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
source.content:
Jesus did not merely point toward light; He declared Himself the light of the world. His life reveals the Father, exposes the darkness of sin, and opens the way to life. The promise in His words belongs to those who follow Him. We cannot ask His light to guide our steps while insisting that our own desires have the final word. The Lord who shows us the way also calls us to come after Him.

John's Gospel repeatedly places light beside darkness. People may resist the light because it uncovers deeds they would rather conceal (John 3:19–21). Yet exposure in the presence of Jesus can become the beginning of freedom. He does not invite us to confess so we can remain under shame. Through His death and resurrection, He offers forgiveness and a new life in which truth can be welcomed. Following Him means bringing our motives, habits, and choices into His presence and receiving His direction through His Word.

Where have you been asking for clarity while keeping part of your life hidden? Bring that place honestly before Christ today. Read His words, confess what they reveal, and take one step consistent with the truth. It may mean ending a secret compromise, telling someone the truth, or seeking help for a struggle you cannot wisely carry alone. The light of life is not a spotlight meant to destroy you; it is the presence of the Savior who leads those who follow Him.

Need Prayer or Counseling? If you need guidance or help bringing a struggle into the light, share your request through Prayer / Counseling. Sign in with your email so our team can respond and follow up with you more easily. We would be honored to stand with you.
prayerPoints: Lord Jesus, shine Your truth into every place where I have been walking without Your direction. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Father, expose the hidden compromise that has weakened my fellowship with You. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Holy Spirit, break the fear of confession and lead me into honest repentance. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Lord, deliver me from the deceptive voices that make darkness appear safe or profitable. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Father, give me courage to repair harm and seek trustworthy help where secrecy has held me captive. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Holy Spirit, make the words of Christ clear to me and strengthen my obedience today. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Lord, let the light of Your life become visible through my truthfulness, compassion, and conduct. In Jesus' name. Amen.
faithDeclarations: Jesus Christ is the light of the world, and I will follow Him.
His truth can expose sin and lead me into freedom.
I will bring my life into the light rather than protect a hidden compromise.
The light of life will guide my next faithful step.
source.christianQuotes: “The light of Christ does more than reveal where you have wandered; it shows you whom to follow home.” — Moses Afolabi
source.propheticDeclaration: May the light of Jesus Christ break through every confusion and hidden bondage that has troubled your steps. I declare courage to receive the truth, grace to repent, and wisdom to walk in His Word. May the life He gives be seen in your decisions and become a witness to those around you. In Jesus' name. Amen.
source.author: Rev. Moses Afolabi

drafts.title: Ìhè Dị Ebube
drafts.content:
Jizọs egosighị nanị ebe ìhè dị; O kwupụtara na Ya onwe Ya bụ ìhè nke ụwa. Ndụ Ya na-ekpughe Nna, na-ekpughe ọchịchịrị nke mmehie, na-emeghekwa ụzọ nke ndụ. Nkwa dị n'okwu Ya bụ nke ndị na-eso Ya. Anyị enweghị ike ịrịọ ka ìhè Ya duzie nzọụkwụ anyị ma ka na-esi ọnwụ na ọchịchọ nke onwe anyị ga-ekwu okwu ikpeazụ. Onyenwe anyị nke na-egosi anyị ụzọ na-akpọkwa anyị ka anyị soro Ya.

N'Oziọma Jọn, a na-atụnyere ìhè na ọchịchịrị ugboro ugboro. Ndị mmadụ nwere ike ịjụ ìhè n'ihi na ọ na-ekpughe omume ha gaara achọ izochi (Jọn 3:19–21). Ma ikpughe ihe zoro ezo n'ihu Jizọs nwere ike ịbụ mmalite nke nnwere onwe. Ọ naghị akpọ anyị ka anyị kwupụta mmehie anyị ka anyị wee nọgide n'okpuru ihere. Site n'ọnwụ Ya na mbilite n'ọnwụ Ya, Ọ na-enye mgbaghara na ndụ ọhụrụ ebe a pụrụ ịnabata eziokwu. Iso Ya pụtara iweta ebumnobi anyị, omume anyị na nhọrọ anyị n'ihu Ya, ma nata nduzi Ya site n'Okwu Ya.

Olee akụkụ ị na-arịọ ka ihe doo gị anya ma ị ka na-ezochi otu akụkụ nke ndụ gị? Weta ihe ahụ n'eziokwu n'ihu Kraịst taa. Gụọ okwu Ya, kwupụta ihe ha na-ekpughe, ma mee otu nzọụkwụ kwekọrọ n'eziokwu. Nke a nwere ike ịpụta ịkwụsị nkwenye nzuzo gị na mmehie, ịgwa mmadụ eziokwu, ma ọ bụ ịchọ enyemaka maka mgba nke ọ bụghị amamihe ibu naanị gị. Ìhè nke ndụ abụghị ọkụ nchọcha e mere iji bibie gị; ọ bụ ọnụnọ Onye Nzọpụta nke na-edu ndị na-eso Ya.

Ị chọrọ ekpere ma ọ bụ ndụmọdụ? Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ nduzi ma ọ bụ enyemaka iji weta mgba gị n'ìhè, zipu arịrịọ gị site n'akụkụ Ekpere / Ndụmọdụ. Banye n'iji adreesị ozi ịntanetị gị ka ndị otu anyị nwee ike ịza gị ma na-esochi okwu gị n'ụzọ dị mfe karị. Ọ ga-abụụrụ anyị ihe ùgwù iguzonyere gị.
prayerPoints: Onyenwe anyị Jizọs, mee ka eziokwu Gị na-enwu n'ebe ọ bụla m jere ije n'enweghị nduzi Gị. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
Nna, kpughee nkwenye nzuzo m na mmehie nke mere ka mmekọrịta mụ na Gị daa mbà. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
Mmụọ Nsọ, gbajie egwu nke ikwupụta mmehie, ma duga m ná nchegharị sitere n'ezi obi. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
Onyenwe anyị, napụta m n'aka olu aghụghọ ndị na-eme ka ọchịchịrị yie ebe nchekwa ma ọ bụ ihe bara uru. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
Nna, nye m obi ike idozi ihe ọjọọ m mere na ịchọ enyemaka a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi n'ebe izochi ihe jidere m n'agbụ. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
Mmụọ Nsọ, mee ka okwu Kraịst doo m anya, ma mee ka nrubeisi m sie ike taa. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
Onyenwe anyị, ka ìhè nke ndụ Gị pụta ìhè site n'ịgwa eziokwu, ọmịiko na omume m. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
faithDeclarations: Jizọs Kraịst bụ ìhè nke ụwa, m ga-esokwa Ya.
Eziokwu Ya nwere ike ikpughe mmehie ma duga m ná nnwere onwe.
M ga-eweta ndụ m n'ìhè kama ichebe nkwenye nzuzo m na mmehie.
Ìhè nke ndụ ga-edu nzọụkwụ ọzọ m ga-eji ikwesị ntụkwasị obi mee.
drafts.christianQuotes: “Ìhè Kraịst anaghị ekpughe naanị ebe ị kpafuru; ọ na-egosi gị Onye ị ga-eso laghachi n'ụlọ.” — Moses Afolabi
drafts.propheticDeclaration: Ka ìhè Jizọs Kraịst banye n'ọgba aghara ọ bụla na agbụ zoro ezo nke na-enye nzọụkwụ gị nsogbu. Ana m ekwupụta obi ike ịnabata eziokwu, amara ichegharị, na amamihe ije ije n'Okwu Ya. Ka ndụ Ọ na-enye pụta ìhè ná mkpebi gị, ma bụrụ ihe àmà nye ndị gbara gị gburugburu. N'aha Jizọs. Amen.
